question: A charged particle with specific charge $\alpha = q/m$ enters a region of space with velocity $\vec{v} = v_0 \hat{i}$. The region contains a uniform magnetic field $\vec{B} = B_0 \hat{i}$ and a uniform electric field $\vec{E} = E_0 \hat{j}$. Analyze the forces to predict the shape of the particle's trajectory.

options.B: Uniform circular motion in the y-z plane.
options.C: Parabolic path in the x-y plane.
